text:
Lena: Heads-up 9	noticed inconsistency in the quotas docs: embeddings example still says "per-request". That will confuse customers. I opened a tiny PR to flip it to "per-token" and add a sample calc for 1k tokens: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8410
Marco: Nice catch. I'll update the JS + Python snippets to use the SDK tokenizer helper and swap raw header names to `X-Usage-Tokens`. Keeping a raw-header appendix for sysintegrators.
Asha: On dashboards 	 the grafana panel link in the rate-limits page 403s for external users. I'll replace it with the public metering dashboard URL and update the panel id to `metering.tokens.total`. Opening PR for that link fix.
Lena: Can we also add a migration note that maps old header names (X-Rate-Limit) to the new ones and explains burst credits behavior briefly? Support asked for copy they can paste.
Marco: Will add a one-paragraph migration blurb at the top of the quota section. Also swapping the example code to `client.usage.fetchRange()` and showing cost calc: tokens / 1000 * price.
Asha: Link PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8412. Ran local link-check, no more 403s.
BuildBot: CI: lint ok on 8410, 8412 queued for examples-smoke and link-check.
Marco: Pushed snippets and migration note to 8410. Left the raw header example below for completeness.
Lena: Plan: land Asha's link PR first, then Marco's snippets. Ping here if CI flakes. Thanks!
